wth.text: The Weatherlight began as a ship Urza built, and its first voyage under Captain Jhoira was a rescue.
Urza later entrusted it to a Zhalfirin family, and Sisay inherited it after the Lord of the Wastes killed them.
Sisay gathered a crew around it, including Gerrard, Rofellos and Mirri, who came aboard to find the Legacy artifacts, and later Crovax, who gladly left his rotting family behind.
When the ship planeshifted to Rath, the Predator ambushed it and took hostages, and Gerrard was knocked overboard.
The Weatherlight escaped to the portal Ertai held open, then fought the Predator again over Urborg, where Tahngarth killed Greven and the Predator was sent crashing into the Stronghold.

tmp.text: Gerrard and the heroes of the Weatherlight set out across stormy Rath to find Volrath's stronghold, because Volrath had Sisay abducted to lure the ship there.
Greven's Predator ambushed the Weatherlight and overpowered its crew, while barbed slivers formed a deadly hedge around the ship.
Gerrard still led the Weatherlight to Rath, freed Sisay and retook the Legacy from Volrath.
The Weatherlight then smashed the Predator into the Stronghold and escaped through the Erratic Portal, and at Urborg Tahngarth killed Greven after Crovax dominated his mind.

exo.text: With Sisay and pieces of the Legacy rescued, the Weatherlight crew had to retreat through Volrath's Stronghold toward the portal off Rath.
The Weatherlight dragged the Predator behind it as it fled, and flowstone lunged at the ship as if it had taken on Greven's rage.
Meanwhile a change came over Crovax, whose bloodlust threatened the ship itself.

ulg.text: Urza built the Weatherlight and powered it with the energies of Serra's Realm.
On Rath, Greven il-Vec commandeered the ship and confiscated Legacy pieces for Volrath, though Karn got them back from the Sliver Queen.
In the end the Dominarians won the war thanks to the Weatherlight crew, but the Metathran race died out with it.

mmq.text: The Weatherlight crash-landed in Mercadia, where the Cho-Arrim stole it and Mercadia City soldiers arrived to arrest the crew, who were soon entangled in local power struggles.
Takara brokered a deal that the crew would repair the ship for the magistrate in exchange for freedom.
Volrath's plot was revealed, and the crew and rebels stormed the hidden underground hangar to reclaim their ship.
Karn took control of the Weatherlight through its engine, and it rammed and destroyed Volrath's Recreant before bursting from the hangar as Mercadia fell.
With Sisay restored and the Legacy recovered, the Weatherlight sailed home to Dominaria.

inv.text: When the Phyrexian Invasion began in 4205 AR, the Weatherlight crew fought it on many fronts, including the defense of Llanowar and the attack on Benalia.

Multani placed his mind inside the ship to fight the Phyrexians, but at Urborg the Primevals destroyed it, and Karn had it reborn with the Thran Tome, giving it a consciousness that displaced Multani.
The Weatherlight then absorbed the white mana of the Null Moon, destroying the moon and shielding the dwarves from Yawgmoth.
Gerrard, Urza and Karn completed the Legacy and destroyed Yawgmoth, and the Weatherlight sank off Urborg, leaving Sisay without a ship.

pls.text: The Weatherlight carried a Minotaur army from Hurloon to Urborg, and the battle for southern Urborg was quickly won.
When the Predator attacked again, Tahngarth killed Greven il-Vec and Sisay crashed the Predator into the Stronghold.
The Weatherlight later drove Crosis back into his tar pit and crashed, and Karn emerged from it with the Thran Tome.

apc.text: Led by Gerrard, the Weatherlight entered Rath's atmosphere to rescue Sisay, but Greven's Predator ambushed it and Vhati's fire capsized the ship, sending Gerrard tumbling from the deck.
It crash-landed in Skyshroud, and later crossed the portal boosted by the Skyshaper, leaving Ertai behind on Rath.
Sisay discovered that the Weatherlight's mirrored hull could be used as a defensive weapon.
At the end, Gerrard flew the ship through the Null Moon to channel its white mana into Yawgmoth, and the Weatherlight crashed after the Legacy Weapon was activated.

plc.text: The Weatherlight set sail from Benalia with Gerrard aboard, after Sisay agreed to rescue Starke's daughter from Volrath in exchange for information about the Legacy.
Starke betrayed her, opening a portal at Volrath's command so that massive hands dragged Sisay away.
The Weatherlight then sailed back to Benalia without Sisay aboard.
Later, the ship dropped from above into a band of ogres, scattering them and leaving only Maraxus.

dom.text: Sixty years after the Mending, Jhoira spotted the wreck of the Weatherlight on the sea floor, hired the Vodalian Ziva to raise it, and restored it with a new hull seed.
Tiana, moved by the ship's skeleton, recognized it as Gerrard's blade, and Raff showed his skill by creating an illusion of the original Weatherlight, until the ship was whole and ready to launch.
A mushroom growing in the hold became Jhoira's first crew member, and she assembled a new crew against Belzenlok's Cabal.
The Weatherlight collected Gideon and Liliana, and Jace later landed on the moving ship to warn that Bolas was preparing a trap for planeswalkers.
When Yargle flung itself at the ship, Muldrotha pried its jaws open, and in the end Belzenlok was slain by the Weatherlight crew and the Gatewatch.

dmu.text: Karn summoned the Weatherlight with an amulet, and aboard it he proposed forcing the Phyrexians into open war.
Jhoira then gave the Weatherlight to Shanna Sisay and returned to the Mana Rig.
Over Shiv, Darigaaz destroyed a Phyrexian monster attacking the ship, but later a skeletal dragon tore a hole in its wing, and the Weatherlight had to land in Otaria with cracked moderator rods.
The Phyrexian disguise corrupted the ship into a monstrosity that rained powerbolts, killing Velena and Elmegraun.
Shanna, Tiana and Slimefoot escaped, and the ship flew away in its transformed state.
